title_ar: ألعاب إبداعية عبر الشاشة — أو بدون الشاشة
practice_model_ar: عند اختيار أي لعبة تظهر شاشة اللعب مباشرة أولًا مع تنقل سابق/التالي بين الألعاب، ثم الشرح والطباعة أسفلها. يمكن طباعة الورقة الجاهزة أو تصميم ورقة A4 مخصصة بالرسم والخطوط والأشكال والصور المتوافقة مع الأجهزة القديمة.

features: direct single-frame five-step viewer with previous/next/autoplay/overview
direct screen game engine with attempts hints retry and descriptive round results
paper and off-screen path for every game
printable downloadable worksheets
shared drawing board
shared name-based recorded audio assets from drawing-writing-foundations without duplicated audio folders
local optional result history export and delete
offline-first PWA shell
wide-screen default five-step overview in one visual stage
mobile automatic five-step sequence followed by full overview
persistent previous and next navigation
50 additional creative games across all readiness levels
20 multi-choice checkmark discrimination exercises across all readiness levels
large option grids on screen with multiple correct selections
printable checkmark worksheets with empty boxes matching the exercise rule
shared trace geometry for dots and paths across lesson viewer game canvas and worksheets
numbered checkpoints with explicit red start and green finish
clearer five-step overview especially on wide tablets
small subordinate checkboxes keep the visual object dominant on screen and print
compact non-sticky site header
direct game-first opening without intermediate detail screen
previous and next navigation across games inside each level
five-step overview with no unused lower stage space
A4-ratio custom worksheet designer with pen lines shapes text and image stamps
shared repository UI icon folder for legacy device compatibility
reuse of say-and-name object and word-image assets as stable visual fallbacks
small bottom check indicator toggled by tapping the target object
